name: Tokkei Kikou Rizaru
source:
Elite security agent Rizaru has been tasked 
to find out what's going down in the haven of debauchery 
called Deloit Town. She disguises herself as 
a prostitute, infiltrates, and spies. 

Rizaru is all pro. She'll have sex to keep her cover. 
But in Deloit the best souls are swallowed in sin... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE119513.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
精英保安特工莉扎鲁奉命调查堕落之都德洛伊特镇发生的事情。她伪装成妓女潜入其中，展开侦察。

莉扎鲁是专业人士，为维持身份可以和人上床。

但在德洛伊特，最优秀的灵魂都会被罪恶吞噬……

[译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE119513.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
